question: Is the declining alpha (0.0537 peak -> 0.0148 at update 1725) the same pathology that killed both pilots?
answer: No. It is correct regulation, and the distinguishing evidence is the log-prob.

distinguishing_evidence.failed_pilots: alpha fell WHILE log-prob diverged AWAY from target (+57 -> -293). The controller had no reachable setpoint, so it slid regardless of the policy.
distinguishing_evidence.current_run: log-prob is PINNED near target (-6.6 to -8.1 across 1300 updates, mean -7.42 vs target -8.4) and sits above target in 20 of the last 20 samples, so alpha SHOULD decrease. It is responding to a real signal.

critic_is_learning: Q grew from ~0.0 to ~+0.4 over the same span, so the value function carries real signal rather than collapsing.

projection.assessment: entropy pressure becomes negligible late in training, which is standard SAC annealing once the policy has settled at its target entropy

watch_condition: if log-prob starts diverging from -8.4 while alpha continues to fall, that WOULD be the pathology recurring
